reason: Machine lens: all opcodes are plain 65SC12 (STX/LDX zp, DEC zp, BCS; PHX/PLX removed), no Rockwell bit ops. Recount (from LDA save_start_hi,Y to STA rb_end, JSR included): old 62 cycles, 33 bytes; new 52 cycles on the no-borrow path (BCS taken, same page: &9DED->&9DF3), 61 with the borrow (BCS 2 + DEC zp 5 + DEC zp 5), 38 bytes. Saving 10 common / -9 borrow, ~9.7 at 3% borrow; +5 bytes. SBC #7 with C=0 = lo-8, C=1 iff no borrow, matching SEC/SBC #8; C=0 after the hi ADC holds since start+offset is an arena/main RAM address below &4000. Decimal mode not an issue (old code also SBCs; render runs with D clear). Zero page &41-&48 is renderer-only: rb_p8 lo and rb_part3 lo have no other readers in src (compiled restores use &C0-&C3 only); rb_part3 is read only on the X=2 pass before the STX, never on the X=0 pass. Exit C=1 from columns preserved; N/Z differ at no_part but DEX overwrites them. Branch ranges fine (BEQ no_part +&30, BPL each_part -&3A). Layout: no_part moves &9DFD->&9E02 so BEQ no_part taken now crosses (+1, ~1.06 a pass, noted by the candidate). The candidate's 'no hot branch changes' is incomplete: everything to the end of bank 4's code moves 5 bytes, so BEQ gathered (&9EFD) stops crossing (-1 taken), sky's BEQ out (&A2F7) starts crossing (+1 taken), LDA straight_sprite_hi,X (&A4E4->&A4E9, ren_draw_sprite every draw) now crosses for sprites &17-&1B (+1), LDY wa_rows_guess,X (&A0F5->&A0FA, world_of_address) now crosses for X=6..10 (+1), and the straight sprites from straight_35 (&A530 on) shift, changing (col_ptr),Y crossings. These are small layout effects, consistent with the candidate's own measured -13 a pass (seed 1) against the 21.3 claimed; the gate's bench decides. Nothing wrong on the machine level: not refuted, but the per-pass gain should be taken from measurement (~13), not 21.3.
